description: This file is a shell script used for testing the merging behavior of notes in a version control system (likely Git). It sets up various scenarios with commits, notes, and merge configurations to verify the correctness of note merging strategies such as 'ours', 'theirs', 'union', 'cat_sort_uniq', and handling invalid strategies.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: A function to verify the state of notes for a particular reference and commit suffix by comparing the actual notes and log output with expected files.
